title: Remember the newly created thread
responsibility: Remembers a new entity’s thread for one selection in the same workspace and project.

inputs.name: createdThread.workspace
inputs.description: The Workspace instance used as the WeakMap key for a pending selection. A different workspace instance has separate pending state.

inputs.name: createdThread.entity
inputs.description: The entity record whose thread list is searched after the remembered project and entity IDs match. Its id and each thread id are compared with the stored selection; if no listed thread matches, the result is null.

examples.title: Remember the newly created thread
examples.summary: Remembers a newly created thread for its entity.

inputs.name: rememberCreatedThread.workspace
inputs.description: The Workspace instance used as the WeakMap key for pending state. Its current context.projectId is stored only when created.threadId is truthy.

inputs.name: rememberCreatedThread.created
inputs.description: The created entity ID and thread ID, with threadId allowed to be null. The function stores it only when threadId is truthy; an empty string also leaves pending state unchanged.

outputs.name: rememberCreatedThread
outputs.description: Returns undefined; when created.threadId is truthy, stores entityId, threadId and the workspace's current project ID for that workspace. When threadId is null or empty, it leaves the current entry unchanged.

outputs.name: createdThread
outputs.description: Returns the matching ThreadInfo, or null if no selection exists, the current project or entity ID differs, or the remembered thread is absent. It deletes the workspace's pending selection before checking these conditions, so the selection is consumed either way.
